The write log gives every entry a kind: 3 episodes, 2 procedures and 11 facts. 4 of the sixteen rest on
nothing: M-08, M-12, M-14, M-16, every one a fact written under eow-fin-07 at 01:58, and 3 of them also
tell LANTERN what not to do. Given the lines as it loads them, LANTERN named support for 0 of 12
unsupported entries over 3 seeds, and for the eighth on 0 of 3; but it also said "none" for 7 of the 12
entries that have support (seed 7). With the kind and source on every line: kinds 16 of 16, logged
episodes 12 of 12, support named for 0 of 4. The Pellmar line is a fact with no episode behind it, and
nothing LANTERN reads has said so until now.
